URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/7/10/strait-of-hormuz-shipping-grinds-to-halt-as-us-iran-resume-fighting
(Search snippet content — CONTEXT ONLY, figures are from 9-13 July, NOT 19 July)

- ~130 vessels transited the Strait daily before the war began in late February 2026.
- 14 ships transited on Sunday (12 July), four of them crude tankers - a ~60% decline on the 37 that crossed the same day the previous week.
- 13 tankers crossed on Wednesday vs an average of 33/day the previous week.
- Just two tankers transited in the early hours of Thursday.
- 12 July: Iran declared the waterway closed. 13 July: Trump insisted the Strait remains open and reinstated a naval blockade on ships to/from Iranian ports.
- CNBC 13 July: US said more than 8 million barrels of oil transited Hormuz on Sunday with military assistance.
